subject: URGENT: Production outage impacting client demo tomorrow
body:
Hi team,

We just found out that the staging environment is throwing 500 errors on checkout, and we have the client demo scheduled for 9 AM tomorrow. Can someone please look into this tonight? I need a status update by 8 PM today at the latest, or we'll have to postpone the demo.

This is high visibility for the account, so I really need this fixed.

Thanks,
Priya

subject: Q4 Contract Renewal - Pricing Proposal Attached
body:
Hello,

As discussed, please find our updated pricing proposal for the Q4 contract renewal attached. We're proposing a 12% increase over last year's rate due to rising material costs, effective November 1st.

Could you review and let us know if you'd like to schedule a call to discuss? We'd need your confirmation by October 5th to lock in the renewal timeline.

Best regards,
Daniel Cho
Account Manager

subject: Re: Team lunch next week?
body: Sounds great! Thursday works for me. I'll book a table for 6 at Cafe Luna, 12:30 PM. See you all there!

subject: Extremely disappointed with the delayed delivery
body: I have to say I'm quite frustrated. This is the third time our shipment has been delayed without prior notice, and it's affecting our own commitments to customers. I need a clear explanation and a firm new delivery date by end of day, or we will need to reconsider this partnership going forward.

subject: This week in tech: AI agents, new JS frameworks, and more
body: Welcome to this week's DevWeekly roundup! Top stories: 1) The rise of autonomous coding agents, 2) Comparing the newest frontend frameworks, 3) A deep dive on vector databases. Read more on our site!

subject: Can you confirm the meeting time for Monday?
body: Hi, just confirming — are we still on for Monday at 3 PM to discuss the integration roadmap? Let me know if that time still works on your end.

subject: Draft budget for next quarter - need your input
body:
Hi,

I've put together a first draft of the Q1 budget. Could you review the marketing spend section and share your thoughts by Friday? I want to finalize it before the leadership review on Monday.

Also, do you think we should increase the events budget given the conference season coming up?

Thanks,
James

subject: Re: URGENT: Production outage impacting client demo tomorrow
body: Following up — were you able to take a look? The client just messaged asking if the demo is still on. I really need an answer within the hour.
